title: [He's Yangchao recipe ameliorates premature ovarian insuffi-ciency by regulating 8-oxoguanine DNA glycosylase 1 in mice].
authors: Hu, Renxin; Zhao, Ying; Wu, Yu; Zhang, Yuting; Liu, Qing; Lin, Fangxuan; Zhang, Qin; Miao, Chenyun
journal: Zhejiang da xue xue bao. Yi xue ban = Journal of Zhejiang University. Medical sciences
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方改善卵巢早衰的分子机制，涉及OGG1蛋白与DNA氧化损伤，但核心是细胞焦亡与线粒体功能，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅用分子对接验证小分子-蛋白结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the molecular mechanism by which He's Yangchao recipe (HSYC) improves ovarian function in a mouse model of premature ovarian insufficiency (POI). METHODS: Forty ICR mice were used to establish a POI model via intraperitoneal injection of cyclophosphamide and were randomly assigned to four groups: model control group, low-dose HSYC group, high-dose HSYC group, and estradiol group (positive control). Additionally, 10 age-matched ICR mice were selected as the blank control group. After intragastric intervention, the ovarian index, serum follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) levels, and ovarian tissue expression of the FSH receptor (FSHR) were measured. A POI cell model was established by treating the human granulosa tumor cell line with 4-hydroxycyclophosphamide. The cells were divided into four groups: solvent control group, HSYC group, inhibitor control group, and inhibitor+HSYC group, which were treated with dimethyl sulfoxide, HSYC-containing serum and 8-oxoguanine DNA glycosylase 1 (OGG1) inhibitor TH5487, respectively. The expressions of OGG1, mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) oxidative damage markers, and pyroptosis-related proteins were detected by molecular docking, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence, respectively. RESULTS: Compared with the blank control group, the model control group showed a decreased ovarian index (P<0.05) and increased serum FSH level (P<0.01). The ovarian index was higher in both the low- and high-dose HSYC groups compared with the model control group (both P<0.05). FSHR expression in ovarian tissue was lower in the model control group than in the blank control group, but was higher in the high-dose HSYC group compared with the model control group (both P<0.05). Molecular docking confirmed strong binding affinity between the active components of HSYC and OGG1 (binding energy: －8.3 to －6.3 kcal/mol). Western blotting analysis revealed that OGG1 protein expression in the ovaries of the model control group was significantly reduced compared with the blank control group, while it increased in the low-dose HSYC group and the estradiol group (all P<0.05). Immunofluorescence results demonstrated that the expression levels of mitochondrial transcription factor A (TFAM) and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1alpha (PGC-1alpha) decreased in the model control group compared with the blank control group (both P<0.01), whereas the expressions were significantly elevated in the high-dose HSYC group and the estradiol group (all P<0.01). Cell experiments showed that TH5487 intervention increased the expression of 8-oxoguanine (8-OxoG) (P<0.01), while HSYC-containing serum intervention reduced 8-OxoG expression and increased TFAM expression (both P<0.01). The expres-sion of pyroptosis-related proteins (GSDMD, N-GSDMD, caspase-1, IL-1beta) increased after TH5487 intervention (all P<0.05), whereas HSYC-containing serum suppressed their expression (all P<0.05). CONCLUSIONS: HSYC improves POI by upregulating OGG1 expression, mitigating mtDNA oxidative damage, and inhibiting granulosa cell pyroptosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨何氏养巢方（HSYC）改善卵巢功能不全（POI）小鼠模型卵巢功能的分子机制。方法：选取40只ICR小鼠，通过腹腔注射环磷酰胺建立POI模型，并随机分为四组：模型对照组、HSYC低剂量组、HSYC高剂量组和雌二醇组（阳性对照）。另选10只同龄ICR小鼠作为空白对照组。灌胃干预后，测定卵巢指数、血清卵泡刺激素（FSH）水平及卵巢组织中FSH受体（FSHR）的表达。通过用4-羟基环磷酰胺处理人颗粒肿瘤细胞系建立POI细胞模型。将细胞分为四组：溶剂对照组、HSYC组、抑制剂对照组和抑制剂+HSYC组，分别用二甲基亚砜、含HSYC血清和8-氧代鸟嘌呤DNA糖基化酶1（OGG1）抑制剂TH5487处理。通过分子对接、Western blotting和免疫荧光分别检测OGG1、线粒体DNA（mtDNA）氧化损伤标志物及焦亡相关蛋白的表达。结果：与空白对照组相比，模型对照组卵巢指数降低（P<0.05），血清FSH水平升高（P<0.01）。与模型对照组相比，HSYC低剂量组和高剂量组的卵巢指数均升高（均P<0.05）。模型对照组卵巢组织中FSHR表达低于空白对照组，但HSYC高剂量组高于模型对照组（均P<0.05）。分子对接证实HSYC活性成分与OGG1之间具有强结合亲和力（结合能：－8.3至－6.3 kcal/mol）。Western blotting分析显示，与空白对照组相比，模型对照组卵巢中OGG1蛋白表达显著降低，而HSYC低剂量组和雌二醇组中表达升高（均P<0.05）。免疫荧光结果表明，与空白对照组相比，模型对照组中线粒体转录因子A（TFAM）和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1α（PGC-1alpha）的表达水平降低（均P<0.01），而HSYC高剂量组和雌二醇组中表达显著升高（均P<0.01）。细胞实验显示，TH5487干预增加了8-氧代鸟嘌呤（8-OxoG）的表达（P<0.01），而含HSYC血清干预降低了8-OxoG表达并增加了TFAM表达（均P<0.01）。TH5487干预后焦亡相关蛋白（GSDMD、N-GSDMD、caspase-1、IL-1β）的表达增加（均P<0.05），而含HSYC血清抑制了其表达（均P<0.05）。结论：HSYC通过上调OGG1表达、减轻mtDNA氧化损伤并抑制颗粒细胞焦亡来改善POI。
